messages:
samir: heads-up — seeing recurring slowpath on /v1/embeds when clients send mixed-dim arrays + large batches. ~5% of EU traffic hit slowpath this morning; p95 latency jumped 2-3x and SLA alerts fired.

tia: yep saw the traces. slowpath is coming from our fallback codepath that switches quantized kernels + spill-to-cpu for >1M bytes payloads. not surprising with mixed dims.

clara: can you remind me which clients send mixed dims? is this new or just higher volume?

samir: looks like two big customers increased batch sizes after rollout of their aggregation layer. volume spike revealed the edge case.

josh: product question — if we auto-fallback to slowpath, do customers get charged differently? customers are asking why latency increased but cost stayed same.

maya: on infra side, slowpath uses extra host memory which increases amortized GPU time. we should surface a cost delta metric if route changes.

tia: proposal: add an explicit fallback event telemetry with tags: fallback_reason, max_dim, batch_count, bytes, route_version. then compute estimated token-token cost delta in the console.

clara: +1. UX needs to show "Requests affected" and "Estimated additional cost" per time window. Also allow customers to opt into automatic route enforcement (fail-fast vs fallback).

samir: API-level thought: add optional header Prefer-Embed-Route: fast|safe to let customers prefer the fast (fail) path or safe (fallback) path. default remains backward compatible.

josh: I like that header idea, but we need to be careful with docs and support messaging. also update pricing page if we show cost differences.

tia: rough estimator snippet i used in traces to show delta: 
```
# naive example
fast_cost = tokens * 0.00012
slow_cost = tokens * 0.00045
delta = slow_cost - fast_cost
```
numbers are made-up but useful for display.

maya: implement telemetry first. we can start with a GC event that increments fallback_count and attaches the tags. dashboard should show fallback_rate and avg_delta.

clara: can we add alerting in console when fallback_rate > 1% for 10m? customers should be able to opt-out of alerts but default on.

samir: plan: (1) tia to add event+schema for embed_route_fallback; (2) eng-platform (me + clara) to add console panel + alerting; (3) product (josh) to update docs + pricing blurb; (4) ops (maya) to add infra mitigations and emergency knob. timeline: prototype telemetry this week, console panel next week. anyone blocking?

josh: not blocking. need copy for pricing blurb — will draft after we have estimator numbers.

tia: will sketch event schema and PR for runtime by EOD. will include example traces and a small flag to force fallback for testing.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: runtime/fallback-metrics-proto -> canary in eu-1 at 7180000020 (auto-scaled).

maya: verified canary traces — fallback events emitted with tags. looks good.

samir: great. follow-ups: add export to bigquery for ad-hoc analysis, and add a console CTA that explains "How to reduce fallbacks" (batching tips, shape hints, prefer-fast header).

clara: adding UI tickets now, will link here.

samir: thanks all — will post a short note for CS so they can explain to customers. :thumbsup:
